svg.title: Between processes: a job enters a queue and becomes a result
svg.desc: A Rust process encodes an image job, copies it into a shared circular buffer, and a Python process copies it into its receive buffer before producing a thumbnail. The two private-memory platforms remain separate. Dashed mapping links connect each process to the same shared region. Isometric depth represents containment and memory ownership, not latency or physical hardware. Solid arrows carry job bytes; dashed lines identify memory mappings.
svg.metadata: Original illustration. Embedded DM Sans subset: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see public/fonts/dm-sans/LICENSE.txt and https://openfontlicense.org/.
svg.text: Separate private memory. One explicitly shared queue.
Solid arrows: job data / Dashed links: memory mappings
One machine. Depth shows memory ownership; this is a conceptual software layout.
